lines: "I've been going to Bodega Vu. They've got the good cans. Labels still on."
"They've got the same cans as everywhere. They dust them."
"Dusting is a markup with a rag. Nuts to That sells the identical tin for less and doesn't pretend it came from a farm."
"Nuts to That smells like a foot."
"So does the food. At least there's no lying in it."
